news.headline: US stocks slip; Nasdaq -1.07%, S&P 500 -0.51%
news.what_happened: Wall Street closed lower with tech leading declines. US 10Y yield eased 0.7% to 4.89%.
news.why_it_matters: Risk-off tone and a Nasdaq drop of about 1% weigh on Indian IT sentiment and can curb FII appetite at the open.

news.headline: Nifty 50 closed +1.68% at 23,440.8 on previous session
news.what_happened: Indian benchmark rallied strongly in the last session.
news.why_it_matters: After a sharp rally with a weak global cue, a flat-to-soft open is plausible; chasing entries is risky.

news.headline: Crude and rupee flat; WTI $96.5, Brent $104.7, USD/INR 94.89
news.what_happened: Oil is little changed near elevated levels; rupee unchanged.
news.why_it_matters: No fresh crude or currency trigger for airlines, paints, OMCs or IT exporters today.

news.headline: Asia mixed: Hang Seng +0.49%, Nikkei -0.33%
